list_child.name: list_runs
list_child.desc: Retrieve the complete set of experiment runs currently tracked by the lab's logging system. This includes runs in every phase, from freshly started to long since aborted.

get_child.name: get_run
get_child.desc: Look up a single experiment run using its unique identifier and return its full recorded detail. This is the primary way to inspect one run's protocol and status.

list_parent.name: list_sponsors
list_parent.desc: Retrieve the complete list of sponsoring organizations that fund work in the lab. Every sponsor with active or past funding appears in this listing.

get_parent.name: get_sponsor
get_parent.desc: Look up a single sponsoring organization using its unique identifier. Returns the full sponsor record the lab keeps on file.

delete_child.name: delete_run
delete_child.desc: Permanently erase an experiment run record from the lab's logs, an action that cannot be reversed once it completes. Use this only for runs logged in error or superseded by a corrected entry.

set_enum.name: set_run_phase
set_enum.desc: Update the phase of an experiment run to reflect whether it is running, completed, or aborted. Keeping this current is essential for downstream reporting to sponsors.

set_bool.name: flag_needs_review
set_bool.desc: Mark an experiment run as awaiting peer review so reviewers know to look it over before results are shared externally. This flag drives the lab's weekly review queue.

set_ref.name: reassign_sponsor
set_ref.desc: Move an experiment run's funding attribution from one sponsor to another, which is useful when a run was logged under the wrong grant. This change propagates to all sponsor-facing reports.

send.name: notify_sponsor
send.desc: Send a notification to a sponsoring organization regarding an experiment run or its overall funding standing. This is the lab's primary channel for sponsor-facing updates.
